items.q: Can the builder also qualify the system?
items.a: Yes, under your control. We draft the protocols and reports; [executing staff: own engineers or named partner] execute them. Your quality unit approves each protocol before it runs and each report after (EU GMP Annex 15, 2.6).

items.q: Can we buy one stage only?
items.a: [services sold separately, yes or no]. Each service has its own first step and its own documents.

items.q: Do you work on other suppliers' systems?
items.a: For [makes and equipment types serviced]: service and upgrades, starting with a condition survey or an assessment.

items.q: How long from URS to water released?
items.a: About [design to DQ, weeks] to an approved design, then [approved design to FAT, weeks] to the factory acceptance test and [IQ/OQ on site, days] of testing on site. Under WHO TRS 1033, water can be used after at least two weeks of sampling, with your quality unit's approval. Sampling continues for a year.
